subject: [hw] DONE K02 rev 7: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL (DEC07) + larb4/larb5 SLP_CON allow-list; 588919/588919; kernel 0 unknown
body:
DONE K02 rev 7. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit (lead owns commits). Nothing was rebuilt for q10jx: this rev is for the next (decode) image.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588919/588919 (violations 0)   [ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, -O2 -DN2VC_VENC_SLOW=0; last line]

New file sha256 800fd77c... (was e601a947, which is what q10jx should be built from; 7ded4040 is what opus-kern actually used and is functionally the same 273 MHz code without the log line).

What changed:
1. DEC07s ABI rev 3 patch applied to kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL 0x16000000+0x30000, 48-page block map (0x00-0x0c CORE, 0x0d SOC larb5, 0x0e CORE larb6, 0x0f-0x1f SOC, 0x20-0x2f CORE), n2vc_op_block() in the op path and in every POLL wake-up, rev-2 scaffold (RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL 12 / N2VC_WIN_N 13) that collapses when hw-lead lands rev 3. Old ten windows unchanged.
2. Larb policy, my decision per DEC04/opus-dec1/opus-dec2: SMI_LARB_SLP_CON 0xc (smi_reg.h:70) is writable only for changed bits inside bit 0, on BOTH larb5 0x1600d00c and larb4 0x1602e00c; every other word on the two larb pages is read-only (EACCES). larb4 was added after DEC04s trace evidence (board 1794414983); DEC07 shipped it empty.
3. Tests: 28 new checks (per-page power SOC vs CORE, larb read-only except bit 0, bit-masked/exact-offset refusals, 0x2fffc/0x30000 range, core power-off during a POLL on a page -> EACCES, out_done=1, one sleep, 0 violations), model gained a 0x30000 W_VALL window with its own per-page power check. Mutations in /tmp: empty allow-list -> 5 failures, page map all-CORE -> 3.
4. Patch path correction for DEC07s README: the patch header is a/bsd/dev/..., so it applies from gpu/hwcodec/kern, not gpu/hwcodec.

Kernel compile: staged q10at3 + 0298 + relay + my .inc + jpegdev + at.inc, exact CI flags -Wall -Wextra -Werror: clean, 1,328,368 B object, 6 new undefined symbols all in the q10at3 kernel, 0 unknown.

Not done (full list in kern/test_k02/STATUS.md): real interrupts (irq_mode 1) still not implemented (proposal in VCODEC_HW.md section 8); never run on the phone; page map [I] for unnamed vendor pages; header rev 3 is hw-leads; IK must regenerate 0299 with 800fd77c for the next image; q10jx stays on 7ded4040 (2873? no: functionally correct, no log line).

Files: kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc, kern/VCODEC_HW.md (section 0 windows + larb rule, section 7 per-page POLL), kern/test_k02/{t_k02.c,run_tests.sh,STATUS.md}, dsh-state/workers/K02/STATUS.md.
